I told Pree in a thread reply on her message in #central-random that the ticket is #8841.

Where it comes from: yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27) Tobias posted in #central-random that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it for support on ticket #8841.

One thing isn't confirmed. That message was about Tobias's dealer account and the Plains depots and never names Marrow Fieldworks. I asked Pree to check with Tobias that it's the same account. I also warned her not to confuse it with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket about a Door 6 scanner.

The knowledge brain refused my search because its access token isn't tied to any member, so I didn't use it. Instead I read only channels Pree belongs to (#central-random and #central-team). The shared drive showed no account or ticket files.
